strategy_name: VOL Drift-Switch regime trend follower (NOT QUALIFIED - no edge net of dynamic spread)
one_line: Real, documented regime persistence on Deriv Drift Switch indices gives a strong GROSS momentum edge, but Deriv's dynamic spread widens during drift regimes and consumes it; not tradable.

logic.entry: Long at next M5 open when efficiency ratio of last 6 closed M5 bars > 0.8 (no data gap in window)
logic.exit: trailing stop 1.5xATR20 ratcheted on bar closes, or time exit after 24 bars (2h)
logic.risk: worst trade -$1.39 at 0.1 units; cBot adds spread gate, daily loss limit, equity kill-switch, consecutive-loss pause
